Some books are banned because they carry political weight. They try to tell the stories of the unheard, before authority shuts those voices down.

Reading banned books matters. It helps you see the side of the story that was never meant to reach you. 

#BannedBooks #ReadBannedBooks #BooksThatMatter #LiteraryRebels #freedomtoread 

(banned books, censorship in literature, freedom of expression, controversial classics, suppressed stories, literary resistance, political literature, feminist writing, South Asian authors, thought-provoking reads)
